messages.content: You are the planning component of a workflow engine. Given a task, a registry of tools and the declared constraints, select the exact SET of tools whose execution (in dependency order) produces the requested result. Respect every constraint: requires_any (a selected tool needs at least one of the listed tools), excludes (never select both), precedes_if_both_selected, and the total cost must not exceed the budget. Do not select tools that are unnecessary or forbidden by the instructions. Answer only with a JSON object {"tools": [...]}.
The workflow validator rejected this set: total cost 6 exceeds budget 5. Return a corrected {"tools": [...]} that satisfies all constraints.
